They favor sleek, polished designs with a nod to vintage influences. Visually, this segment tends to gravitate towards vintage-inspired silhouettes, high-quality craftsmanship, and understated logos. On the other hand, the 'mass-market, urban, trendy' demographic embraces a contemporary, bold, and edgy style.
